tools.name: get_state_requirements
tools.description: Nonprofit compliance requirements for one US state, from 501c3.help's sourced records: formation, governance, charitable solicitation registration, reporting, tax and employment. Every record carries its official citation and a verification status. Records marked review_required are unsettled and must be presented as such, never as a settled rule. Optionally narrow by topic. Returns a limited number of records, not the whole state.

state.description: State name or two-letter abbreviation, for example 'Kansas' or 'KS'.

topic.description: Optional topic filter, matched loosely, for example 'solicitation', 'reporting', 'tax'.

tools.name: compare_states
tools.description: The same compliance topic across several US states, for deciding where to incorporate or for an organization that operates in more than one state. Each state's records carry their own citation and verification status; a record marked review_required is unsettled and must not be presented as a settled rule. Accepts up to eight states.

states.description: State names or two-letter abbreviations. Up to eight.

topic.description: The topic to compare, for example 'solicitation', 'reporting', 'formation', 'tax'.

tools.name: get_filing_deadlines
tools.description: Every requirement in one US state that has a filing deadline attached, with the deadline in plain words, the form or portal, the fee, and the official citation. Use this for 'what is due and when'. Deadlines on records marked review_required are not settled and must be shown as unconfirmed.
